description: Return the code point at a zero-based index of the anyURI value as an integer. Indexes count code points, as everywhere in Adaptive Script. Negative indexes count from the end, as at does. If the index is out of range, the result is undefined, as for at.

parameters.description: Zero-based code point index, or negative from the end.
parameters.name: index

returns.description: The code point, or undefined if index is out of range.
